newsitem.title: USA: December mutual fund inflows slow - Schwab.
newsitem.headline: December mutual fund inflows slow - Schwab.

text.p: Charles Schwab Corp said Tuesday that cash inflows for mutual funds it sells declined sharply in December, to $127.8 million through December 27 versus $1.1 billion for all of November.
Among categories, domestic growth fund inflows fell to $95.4 million from $539.4 million, and international growth fund inflows dropped to $52.8 million from $277.4 million.
Balanced funds had outflows of $34.6 million versus inflows of $181.5 million, and precious metals funds had outflows of $29.4 million versus outflows of $20.6 million.
"We had a pretty significant slowdown," said a Schwab spokesman. "December is historically slow. Traditionally, investors are rebalancing, shifting portfolios at the end of the year."
